about: Who gets which overlays (docs/complexion-profiles.md, approved by the owner 2026-10-02 as C-7). count = percent chance of 0/1/2/3/4 features; kinds = percent weights of the feature kinds; styles = the tattoo styles a person's style is drawn from; emblems = the emblems members may wear (only members, C-7); sizes = the sizes tattoos may have; hair = pubic hair sizes; adult = chance a feature may be an adult or degrading piece (0 = never; the MCM switch turns all of it off). squalor = percent chance a person of the group lives rough: only they get nasty marks (grime, blood, open wounds, pustules, fresh bruises; tools/paint/traits.py), owner 2026-10-04 -- the elite of the Commonwealth almost never; universal = the universal layer's percents scaled for the group (percent of the base: acne 50 halves it). C-21.

hair_colours.about: One body hair colour per person, matching the hair on their head (owner, 2026-10-04): the family of their head hair colour (tools/make_data.py reads the game's hair colour records into forms) accepts these families of pubic_hair and body_hair templates (the tag's hair, tools/paint/hair.py) -- the same or darker, never another hue. A head colour not listed (another mod's, a dye) rolls one family per person by unknown (percent).
